entities.name: Dragonhawk
entities.description: An anomaly on Bloomburrow, neither truly from the plane nor an elemental, resembling Kolaghan's dragons with four webbed wings and power over dragonstorms.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: Plane of the animalfolk where Dragonhawk appears.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane where the Stormnexus Ritual was performed.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual on Tarkir after which dragonstorms spread through Omenpaths.

entities.name: Bello
entities.description: Theorized Dragonhawk was born on Tarkir and transformed in an Omenpath.

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: Had a vision of Dragonhawk in Pondside around 4564 AR.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Leader of the party who found Dragonhawk and kept everyone together.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: Sneezed awake and alerted Dragonhawk to the party.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who recognized Dragonhawk as a dragon and struck it with lightning.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: Provided a well-aimed arrow wound with copper wire.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: Place where Dragonhawk later attacked the party.

events.summary: Helga has a vision of Dragonhawk in Pondside around 4564 AR.
events.quote: Helga first had a vision of Dragonhawk while in Pondside around 4564 AR .

events.summary: Zoraline sneezes awake, alerting Dragonhawk to Mabel's party; Ral recognizes it as a dragon.
events.quote: Their quiet journey was abruptly disrupted when Zoraline sneezed awake, alerting Dragonhawk to their presence.

events.summary: Dragonhawk swoops at the party; Ral, with Finneas's arrow, strikes it with lightning.
events.quote: Ral called upon his magic to strike the Dragonhawk with a barrage of lightning.

events.summary: Dragonhawk survives, retreats into the storm clouds, and the animalfolk flee toward the foothills.
events.quote: The animalfolk took the opportunity to flee towards the safety of the foothills

events.summary: Dragonhawk returns to attack in Fountainport but is defeated by Maha and flees.
events.quote: was defeated by Maha and fled
